population.site_histories: four constant labeled histories and eight varying histories with frame-unique nuisance labels; one common site order throughout each trace including the guard
population.plant_order: a uniform start for the ordered four-history block and a uniform order of the eight remaining histories

limits: matched site-history distributions at one observation budget; two simultaneous one-sided bounds; unresolved nulls count as possible rejections and unresolved plants as misses
